items.title: Ruth & Bucky Pizzarelli interviewed by Monk Rowe, Saddle River, New Jersey, January 19, 2015
items.q: I worked there with his sister.

ctx.x: My sister was a nurse at St. Joe’s Hospital. And she was working at the emergency room. And Ruth baby here, was there too.
I worked there with his sister.
So she saw me and she fell in love with me.
